data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 argues for the expert by claiming checklists cannot capture dynamic, non-linear dependencies, but it invokes a specific case (Boeing 737 MAX in SCR_006) not contained in this target's own content; treating that external reference as substantive support is unjustified. More importantly, it never identifies evidence within a single evaluation that distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer, which the problem explicitly requires.
